description: This file contains unit tests for the BookUtils class, verifying the behavior of combining book title and series position for display purposes.

classes.name: BookUtilsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of BookUtils methods related to displaying book titles with series information.

methods.name: BookUtilsTest(PredefinedShelfService predefinedShelfService)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a Book instance with a predefined shelf obtained via dependency injection.

methods.name: notShowSeriesPositionIfBookIsNotInSeries
methods.description: Tests that the combined title does not include series information when the series position is null.

methods.name: returnTitleWhenSeriesPositionIsZero
methods.description: Tests that the combined title does not include series information when the series position is zero.

methods.name: showSeriesPositionCorrectly
methods.description: Tests that the combined title correctly appends the series position when it is a positive number.
